_note: FROZEN Stage-3 LLM-FL configuration. This is the single source of truth so both D1 conditions (local-only, LLM-FL) and both heterogeneity endpoints differ ONLY in federation, never in incidental hyperparameters. Base model / LoRA recipe are IDENTICAL to Stage-2 (train_lora_generic.py defaults) so the federated result stays directly comparable to the centralized run.

local_train._note: Per-round LOCAL step budget at each (zone, agent). Kept identical in both D1 conditions (supervisor: 'round count and all training hyperparameters are identical across conditions'). One local epoch per round over the balanced zone data.

fedprox._note: FedProx proximal coefficient mu (Eq 3.33). mu=0 recovers plain FedAvg-style local training. 0.01 is a standard non-IID default; tune here without touching code.

federation._note_stop: Eq 3.73: stop at first round T whose newest 5-round validation MCC_macro window has (max-min) < conv_tol. If never satisfied within max_rounds, report 'not converged by round N'.

partition._note: Attacker = is_sybil==1 (attack_type in 1..6); legitimate = attack_type 0. Each endpoint gives the per-zone TARGET attacker fraction. zone_size 'auto' = the largest EQUAL zone size feasible across ALL endpoints given the real train pools, so every zone in every endpoint is the same size (cleanest D1 control). val/test are NEVER partitioned - they stay whole and shared (frozen, leakage-safe, identical to Stage-2).

overhead._note: Eq 3.71 uses bf16 -> 2 bytes/param. Measured bytes are recorded separately per round in communication.json.

eval._note: Per-round evaluation runs the SAME Stage-2 consensus (omega uniform 1/3, theta frozen) on the FROZEN shared val set. theta is frozen (not recalibrated per round) so the D1 comparison is not confounded by moving calibration.
